data.text:
⚡️A massive typhoon in the Philippines has killed 66 people, with another 26 missing, — writes The Guardian.

The highest number of deaths was recorded in the central province of Cebu, where the typhoon caused sudden flooding and rivers and other water bodies to overflow.

According to forecasters, in the first half of the day, the typhoon moved at a speed of up to 130 km/h with gusts of up to 180 km/h.
